Jason Mowat wrote:
> 1.) With the card 'Hostile Takeover', do you have to beat the opponent's
> bid, or can you tie it? Also, who bids first, the card player or the
> "defending" player?

As with all auctions, a succeeding bid must beat the previous bids.
In Hostile Takeover, since no order is specified (contrast Malkavian
Time Auction), bidding is open.

> 2.) To be ousted from the game, does the opponent have to bleed you for
> more blood than you have, or for the exact amount (i.e. they would blled
> your total pool by 30 blood or 31 blood (unmodified))?

More than your remaining pool is allowable. Any method (not just bleeding)
is allowable, as well.

> 3.) Weapons with an 'R' designator are ranged weapons. Can they be used at
> close range as well?

Yes, as stated in the rules. [6.4.3.2]
